title: Integration Tangles — item-master / pricing / promo
count: 4 tangles across 6 domains · break plan attached

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: interface dependency scan of Oracle RMS/RPM/ReIM integration map + MuleSoft API topology

rows: Item ↔ Pricing writeback
ITEM_MASTER → attributes → zone pricing → retail flags written back to ITEM_MASTER
6 nightly batch + 2 sync APIs
⚠ Price flags on item rows block item-master schema changes; 1.4M weekly price changes contend with item batch window
Make retail a pricing-owned read model; publish price-change events; delete the writeback columns from ITEM_MASTER
Pricing ↔ Markdown
Zone price → markdown optimization → permanent retail override → re-triggers promo eligibility recalc in pricing
4 interfaces
⚠ Markdown step-downs and promo retails race during seasonal exits; mis-sequencing produces below-cost ads
Separate promo retail from permanent retail in the price ladder; one-way flow zone-price → markdown, never back
Cost ↔ Vendor funds
Cost change → deal accrual recalc → deal income adjusts effective cost → re-triggers cost event
3 interfaces
Restated margin at month-end close; ≈$1.8B vendor income exposed to recalc churn
Snapshot cost basis at deal creation (cost_snapshot_dt); accruals never read live cost
Promo ↔ Space
Promo event reserves endcap → POG revision flags promo items → flags re-open the promo event for scope edits
2 interfaces + shared table
Endcap double-booking across 2,300 stores during reset weeks
Stand up a single space-reservation service as the one writer; promo and POG both consume reservations read-only
